notices.title: Short-Term Rental for ADU Text Amendment
notices.agenda_text:
Notice is hereby given that a public meeting will be held before the Bluffdale City Council on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at Bluffdale City Hall, 2222 W 14400 S, which will begin at 6:00 p.m., or as soon thereafter as possible for the purpose of receiving public comment on a proposed Text Amendment to update the City Code as follows:

-	Chapter 3.100.010 - Definitions:  Amend the definition of 'Short-Term Rental' to include accessory dwelling units (ADUs).
-	Chapter 3.100.020: Amend general regulations to allow short-term rental licenses for ADUs, with only one license permitted per property.
-	Chapter 11.20.020: Amend zoning definitions related to short-term rentals and accessory dwelling units to accommodate the use of ADUs as licensed short-term rentals.
-	Chapter 11.340.040(F): Allow internal and detached ADUs to be used as licensed short-term rentals in accordance with BCC 3.100.

City of Bluffdale, Applicant.  Ellen Oakman, Staff Presenter (Application 2026-35).

In addition to attendance at the City Council, if you have any comments or concerns, there are several additional ways to participate:
1.	View meeting on the City's website at www.bluffdale.gov.
2.	Email your comments to councilmeetingcomment@bluffdale.gov for the City Council and include 'STR ADU TA' in the subject line of the email.
3.	Mailed written comments will also be accepted. Please mail to the following:
City of Bluffdale Planning Department
2222 West 14400 South
Bluffdale, UT 84065
For further information, please contact Ellen Oakman at eoakman@bluffdale.gov or 801-849-9473.
